items.title: Pilgrim’s Pride Reports Lower Profit, Sales
items.summary: The chicken and pork manufacturer logged a profit of $13.4 million in the second quarter, citing commodity market pricing reductions.

items.title: Chipotle Mexican Grill Posts Higher Sales, Driven by New Restaurant Openings
items.summary: The fast-casual chain’s revenue rose 9.3% to $3.35 billion as it opened 100 restaurants in its second quarter.

items.title: Meta Stock Slides After Sales Outlook Disappoints Amid Rising AI Costs
items.summary: Meta Platforms stock slid after the social media giant reported second-quarter earnings below expectations.  The Facebook parent's sales forecast was below estimates as well, while its AI spending forecast was upped slightly.  The Menlo Park, Calif.-based Meta earned $6.18 per share from sales of $60.8 billion for the June quarter, according to a company press release.

items.title: Arm Posts Higher Revenue, Profit as AI Demand Drives Growth
items.summary: The company reported a higher first-quarter profit of $270 million as demand for its chip designs exceeded expectations.

items.title: L3Harris Raises Guidance on Higher Profit, Revenue
items.summary: The defense contractor said it now expects full-year earnings between $11.80 and $12.00 a share, up 40 cents from the company’s previous guidance.

items.title: Renault Reports Higher Revenue, Says Cost-Cutting Efforts Bearing Fruit
items.summary: Renault reaffirmed its full-year outlook and said cost-cutting efforts were bearing fruit after reporting revenue growth in the first half of the year.
